findings.issue: Tech-spec Architecture section (line ~46) states SecurityConfig's current state uses 'XorServerCsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler', but the actual SecurityConfig.java imports and instantiates 'ServerCsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler' (non-Xor variant). Tasks 1-3 do not modify SecurityConfig, so this does not block waves 1 tasks, but any later task (e.g. T12 that modifies SecurityConfig) based on this description will apply incorrect context.
findings.fix: Correct tech-spec Architecture 'Modify SecurityConfig' bullet: replace 'XorServerCsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler' with 'ServerCsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler' to match the actual import in backend/src/main/java/com/botfunnel/security/SecurityConfig.java line 17.

findings.issue: Details section (line ~111) instructs: 'Replace the call site inside connect(...) with Sha256Hex.hex(plaintextSecret)'. The actual local variable at line 151 of BotService.java is 'secretHex' (a hex-encoded representation of random bytes), not 'plaintextSecret'. 'plaintextSecret' is a misleading name that implies it is user-supplied plaintext; the real variable is the hex-encoded random webhook secret. A developer following the hint literally will look for 'plaintextSecret' and not find it.
findings.fix: Change 'Sha256Hex.hex(plaintextSecret)' to 'Sha256Hex.hex(secretHex)' in the Details section to match the actual variable name in BotService.connectAfterPreChecks().

findings.issue: What-to-do step 6 offers '@MockitoSpyBean-style hook' as one option for the verify_usesMessageDigestIsEqual test, but the Details section declares the test class as 'Plain JUnit 5; no Spring context'. @MockitoSpyBean requires a Spring test context (it is a Spring Boot 3.4+ annotation for @SpringBootTest). The two options are contradictory: @MockitoSpyBean cannot be used in a context-free unit test. The Implementation hints section correctly resolves this by prescribing MockedStatic<MessageDigest>, but the ambiguity in step 6 may confuse the implementer.
findings.fix: Remove '@MockitoSpyBean-style hook' from step 6's option list (keep only the MockedStatic<MessageDigest> path) since the test is declared as context-free Plain JUnit 5.
